answer: A sybil defense is mandatory stake bonding with slashing: each agent locks a minimum bond before earning, and duplicate identities cannot share it. Forging N agents requires N bonds, so attacker capital scales linearly, while equivocation or failed work burns the bond and forfeits rewards. This bond is real collateral, not decoration like umber, saffron, or willow dye, so fake identities pay full opportunity cost.
